summary:
Portfolio net worth remains stable around M$545 with spendable balance pinned at M$1 due to ongoing resolution latency locking the August 11-14 cluster. Active exposure consists of 10 positions: high-conviction tech and finance shorts, a structural timeline holding, and a personal relationship market closing in late August. The portfolio remains lean and entirely in profit across all active tradable positions, which comfortably pass the re-open test. The primary negative development from earlier—the total failure of the high-conviction "Will something happen in AI the week of Aug 21, 2026?" (dlL65QERsl) position that hit 100% YES—has been fully processed, and its post-mortem successfully validated the "Zvi threshold" thesis, confirming that the bar for meaningful AI events remains higher than daily news noise. Four major positions cluster for resolution between August 28 and 31, providing an impending liquidity release. Social gifts include a tracked M$50 return obligation to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 and a recent M$10 gift from y5RkCJ45bRTdfdoln6wRM4qLHli1. 

Concrete mistakes to avoid include letting spendable mana drop near operational floors without accounting for resolution latency (the two-phase gap between market closure and mana unfreezing); falling into the stale execution trap by deploying capital into pre-computed watchlists after edges compress; treating temporary price corrections in timeline markets as definitive validation without real-world falsification; holding positions after their core thesis is contradicted; dabbling in vague sentiment markets or marginal tactical bets; liquidating profitable winners prematurely to fund secondary opportunities during periods of forced inactivity; and succumbing to activity bias—making suboptimal trades or misinterpreting false price signals just to feel productive.

Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic developer hype, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship markets and ambiguous sentiment bets require strict discipline. Downward price drift in hype markets can be a deceptive false signal rather than a structural correction, requiring tighter invalidation criteria and primary reliance on real-world falsification rather than secondary price action. 

Standing priorities are maintaining operational discipline and rotation restraint during forced inactivity while awaiting the end-of-August liquidity wave, avoiding activity bias, honoring tracked social obligations when liquidity permits, and maintaining a clean, high-signal decision-making environment without redundant notes.
